title: Marta's Warning
text:
*You slide a coin across the bar. Marta pours you something dark and bitter without being asked — apparently the house specialty is whatever she feels like serving.*

Marta: "New in town? I can tell. You've still got hope in your eyes. Give it a week."

*She leans closer, her voice dropping.*

Marta: "Three merchants gone in the last month. Good people — well, mostly good. Aldric was a friend. His shop was torn apart, and the guards called it 'burglary.' But burglars don't take people, stranger. They take things."

*She glances toward the door, checking for eavesdroppers.*

Marta: "If you're here about the trouble — and I think you are — talk to the Guild. The Merchants' Guild. Harren's the head, keeps his offices by the harbor. But watch yourself around that one. He smiles too much for an honest man."

choices.text: Ask about the swordsman by the fire
Thank her and head back to the market to follow up
Keep drinking — the ale loosens your tongue and your muscles
